commentary.text: In July 2026, paid media spend for Harbor Coffee Roasters was $9,860, generating 511 conversions. Cost per acquisition was $19.29. Return on ad spend was 1.76x. Google Ads was the most efficient channel, delivering 348 conversions at $15.89 each.

In August 2026, paid media spend for Harbor Coffee Roasters was $11,252, up 14.1% on last month, generating 617 conversions, up 20.6% on last month. Cost per acquisition was $18.25, down 5.4% (an improvement on last month). Return on ad spend was 1.87x, up 6.1% on last month. Google Ads was the most efficient channel, delivering 389 conversions at $16.27 each.

In September 2026, paid media spend for Harbor Coffee Roasters was $10,760, down 4.4% on last month, generating 549 conversions, down 11.0% on last month. Cost per acquisition was $19.60, up 7.4% (a rise on last month). Return on ad spend was 1.73x, down 7.5% on last month. Google Ads was the most efficient channel, delivering 380 conversions at $15.89 each.

alerts.message: Google Ads reported 885 clicks but GA4 recorded 8 paid-search sessions (1%) on 3 of the last 14 days (Oct 19 to Oct 21). Clicks and sessions normally track closely, so tracking or attribution should be reviewed.

Meta Ads reported 769 clicks but GA4 recorded 33 paid-social sessions (4%) on 3 of the last 14 days (Oct 19 to Oct 21). Clicks and sessions normally track closely, so tracking or attribution should be reviewed.
Website sessions fell sharply on Oct 19 to Oct 21: 64 recorded versus roughly 2,475 expected. This pattern usually points to a tracking outage rather than a real drop in visitors.

commentary.text: In October 2026, paid media spend for Harbor Coffee Roasters was $11,422, up 6.2% on last month, generating 594 conversions, up 8.3% on last month. Cost per acquisition was $19.22, down 2.0% (an improvement on last month). Return on ad spend was 1.76x, up 1.7% on last month. Google Ads was the most efficient channel, delivering 399 conversions at $16.19 each. Please note that some website tracking data was incomplete during part of the period, so web figures may be understated; we are looking into it.
